_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Done: Make a layered post cover

description: Use this when the user wants a cover image for a post, article, note or product, such as "make a cover for my post about X". Pass idea and title (at most about 8 words; write it from the idea when the user gave none), subject (one concrete object to picture; write it from the idea), optionally subtitle, byline, reader, kind (article, note, ecommerce, product), style (an account preset or your own) and formats. Returns the cover spec JSON with layers in occlusion order (background, subject, then title, subtitle and byline as live text), pixel positions for each format (default Instagram 1080x1350 and X 1600x900), structured prompts for the GPT image model, an SVG of each format and a canvas link to move the title, scale the subject and export PNGs without making the picture again. It draws no picture itself, publishes nothing and stores nothing.

background_url.description: Your background picture, once made from the prompt

byline.description: Account or author name, for example @openkrill

formats.description: Sizes to lay out; the first is the size the pictures are made at

idea.description: The post idea the cover is for, in one or two sentences

kind.description: article: Article or blog cover: a strong headline beside one clear picture; note: Note cover (Instagram or Xiaohongshu style): a large headline over a close, friendly picture; ecommerce: Shop poster: the product large in the middle, the offer in words; product: Product design shot: the object as a hero on a clean set, the name below

reader.description: Who the post is for, for example 'founders who run AI agents'

split.description: separate: two pictures, a background plate and a subject cutout; segment: one scene per size that a segmentation model cuts

ink.description: Colour of the title and subtitle

medium.description: What the pictures are, for example a film photograph or a flat paper collage

style.description: An account style preset, or your own style so every cover of one account looks alike

subject.description: One concrete object the picture shows, such as 'a glass jar of folded paper notes'; write one from the idea when the user gave none, since an idea alone gives a vague picture

subject_url.description: Your subject cutout, once made from the prompt

subtitle.description: One short line under the title

title.description: The cover title, at most about 8 words; it stays live text

name: make_cover

canvas_url.description: Opens this cover on the canvas to move the title, scale the subject and export PNG files

spec.description: The cover spec JSON: idea, style, layers in occlusion order, pixel positions per format and the image prompts

svg.description: The cover per format as SVG, the title as live SVG text

title: Make a layered post cover
